fixture: Synthetic legacy native1.3 board, 1x4 cells in two merge groups. The legacy generator drops one corner of the left group; the right group has clue17, a blue long edge and a red vertex note.
scope: Import a known legacy merged board and unmerge the left group through its real UI button (mouse/touch). Preserve the right merged ID and its complete annotations. Undo/Redo, native reload, unmerge the right group, remove annotations on replaced cell/long edge, Undo restores them. Units also cover native1.1 without snapshot, legacy deformation, layout, exclusions after migration and invalid metadata rejection. Unknown/custom or already excluded legacy graphs and split/sculpt mixtures remain unsupported.
